## What problem does this solve?

Describe the use case the change would enable.  Real-world examples
help reviewers weigh the proposal.

## Proposed change

A concise description of what you would like the SDK to do.  If the
change adds public C API, include the proposed function signature(s)
and parameter semantics.

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches did you weigh?  Why is the proposal preferable?

## Compatibility

- Does the change affect the public C ABI?
- Does it require a SQLite schema change?
- Does it change the on-disk format of chunk databases?
- Does it require a minimum compiler / OS version bump?

## Additional context

Links to prior discussion, related issues, or upstream references.
